releaseNotes: v5.1.8 — Dashboard rebuilt: account details first (name, number, prop firm, starting and current balance, equity, profit/loss total + today, trades total + today, win rate, profit factor), then live Goat Funded Trader 2-Step GOAT $5K rule gauges — profit target (8% Phase 1 / 6% Phase 2), 4% daily drawdown, 10% static maximum loss, 3 profitable days — all verified from GFT's own help centre and worked out from your real trades, with plain-English 'What this means' lines, count-up numbers and animated gauges. Same silent /S in-app update as v5.1.4 and same main-process OCR as v5.1.3.
